# A test reads a node's prop whose value reads a `var` written in a block of
# the view, which is state of that block wherever the block is rendered:
# joined to the instance rendering it where the block renders once (once,
# where the instance is reached through another and shadows a var of its
# own), and an instance of a component synthesized for the block where it
# renders other than once -- under an `if` over state (branch), per copy
# under a `for` (rows), or as a tab's panel (panel). The Go targets emitted
# the var bare and html threw on it. A block like that inside another
# instance is refused (nested); the interpreter answers it, being the
# reference.

sngl test --platform=none once.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=html once.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'

! sngl test --platform=html nested.sngl
stderr 'nested.sngl:22:40: `text` reads `taps`, state of a block rendered once per copy or branch, which a test reaches only where the block is written in the body of the component the test takes, outside any other such block'

sngl test --platform=none nested.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'

-- once.sngl --
import . "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"

component inner ui.node {
    ui.vbox {
        var taps = 0
        ui.button #tap(text="{taps}", @click { taps += 1 })
    }
}

component outer ui.node {
    var taps = 5
    ui.vbox {
        var taps = 0
        ui.button #own(text="{taps}", @click { taps += 1 })
    }
    inner #b
}

func testOnce(t Test, c outer) {
    c.b.tap.click()
    t.assert(c.b.tap.text == "1")
    c.own.click()
    c.own.click()
    t.assert(c.own.text == "2")
    t.assert(c.taps == 5)
}
-- branch.sngl --
import . "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"

component branch ui.node {
    var on = true
    ui.button #flip(text="flip", @click { on = !on })
    if on {
        ui.vbox {
            var taps = 0
            ui.button #tap(text="{taps}", @click { taps += 1 })
        }
    }
}

func testBranch(t Test, c branch) {
    if c.tap != null {
        c.tap.click()
    }
    t.assert(c.tap != null && c.tap.text == "1")
    c.flip.click()
    c.flip.click()
    t.assert(c.tap != null && c.tap.text == "0")
}
-- rows.sngl --
import . "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"

const items list[string] = ["a", "b"]

component rows ui.node {
    for var it = items {
        ui.hbox {
            var taps = 0
            ui.button #tap(text="{it}{taps}", @click { taps += 1 })
        }
    }
}

func testRows(t Test, c rows) {
    c.tap[1].click()
    c.tap[1].click()
    t.assert(c.tap[0].text == "a0")
    t.assert(c.tap[1].text == "b2")
}
-- panel.sngl --
import . "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"

component panel ui.node {
    var selected = 0
    ui.tabs(:selected=selected) {
        ui.tab(label="One") {
            var taps = 0
            ui.button #tap(text="{taps}", @click { taps += 1 })
        }
    }
}

func testPanel(t Test, c panel) {
    if c.tap != null {
        c.tap.click()
    }
    t.assert(c.tap != null && c.tap.text == "1")
}
-- nested.sngl --
import . "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"

component inner ui.node {
    var on = true
    if on {
        ui.vbox {
            var taps = 0
            ui.button #tap(text="{taps}", @click { taps += 1 })
        }
    }
}

component outer ui.node {
    inner #b
}

func testNested(t Test, c outer) {
    if c.b.tap != null {
        c.b.tap.click()
    }
    t.assert(c.b.tap != null && c.b.tap.text == "1")
}
